meta.scope: examples/tasklane: sign-up, dashboard and task list, archive, settings, app shell
meta.method: Static review of routes, components, styles and locale files against the primary flows, the token scales and WCAG 2.2 AA

summary: Both primary tasks have blockers. Sign-up wipes what the visitor typed when the server rejects it, saving a new task throws the typed title away, and the task list can only be operated with a mouse: rows are clickable divs and the delete control is an unnamed icon that deletes at once with no undo. At the 360px phone viewport the 480px sidebar pushes the list off-screen, and zoom is disabled. Around these, the task list has no loading, empty or error state, focus is invisible on every .btn button, and task titles are cut off with no way to read them.

findings.title: Saving a new task discards the typed title
findings.criterion: Primary task completes and the user's input is kept (severity table: data or input lost)
findings.observed: <button onClick={onClose}>Save</button>: the title state is never sent, and api.ts has no create call
findings.expected: Save creates the task, shows it in the list, and closes the dialog only on success.
findings.impact: Adding a task, a primary task, cannot be completed: the dialog closes and the typed title is gone.
findings.fix: Call a create endpoint with the title, close on success and keep the input with an error message on failure.

validation.evidence: AddTaskModal.tsx:5 and :10 hold the title only in local state; :11 only closes; src/api.ts exports open and remove only.
validation.intent_checked: No other code path creates tasks.

evidence.caption: Source lines at src/components/AddTaskModal.tsx:11, captured from the reviewed checkout

findings.title: Sign-up clears every field when the server rejects the request
findings.criterion: Input is preserved across errors (WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.7 Redundant Entry; error recovery heuristic)
findings.observed: if (!res.ok) { setEmail(""); setPassword(""); setError(...) }
findings.expected: Keep the email, clear only the password if policy requires it, and show the error next to the field that caused it.
findings.impact: Any rejected sign-up (taken email, weak password, a 5xx) sends the visitor back to an empty form; many will not retype.
findings.fix: Remove the two resets on failure; map the server error to the field and move focus to it.

validation.evidence: submit() is the form's onSubmit (SignupForm.tsx:25); the resets run on every non-OK response.
validation.intent_checked: No comment or setting asks for the reset; the password field could be cleared for security, the email has no such reason.

evidence.caption: Source lines at src/components/SignupForm.tsx:18, captured from the reviewed checkout

findings.title: Task rows open only on mouse click
findings.criterion: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.1.1 Keyboard
findings.observed: <div className="task-title" onClick={() => api.open(task.id)}>
findings.expected: A <button> or <a href> that opens the task, reachable with Tab and operable with Enter/Space.
findings.impact: Keyboard and switch users cannot open any task, so the primary flow stops at the list.
findings.fix: Render the title as a link to the task (or a button) instead of a clickable div.

validation.evidence: inventory click_handlers: div without role, tabindex or key handler; no parent element handles keys.
validation.intent_checked: No other control on the row opens the task; the only other control is delete.

evidence.caption: Source lines at src/components/TaskList.tsx:15, captured from the reviewed checkout

findings.title: Delete is an icon-only button with no accessible name
findings.criterion: WCAG 2.2 SC 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
findings.observed: <button className="icon-btn" onClick={...}><Trash2 /></button>
findings.expected: <button aria-label="Delete task: {title}">
findings.impact: Screen readers announce "button" on every row; the delete step of the primary flow cannot be identified.
findings.fix: Add an aria-label naming the action and the task; keep the icon aria-hidden.

validation.evidence: inventory icon_buttons; lucide-react icons render an aria-hidden SVG with no title.
validation.intent_checked: No visually hidden text or tooltip inside the button.

evidence.caption: Source lines at src/components/TaskList.tsx:16, captured from the reviewed checkout

findings.title: Deleting a task is immediate, with no confirmation or undo
findings.criterion: Destructive actions are confirmed or undoable (error prevention heuristic; WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.4 by analogy)
findings.observed: onClick={() => api.remove(task.id)} sends DELETE on the first click
findings.expected: Delete with an undo toast (preferred for a single task), or a confirmation naming the task.
findings.impact: A mis-tap on a 20px icon next to the title permanently removes the task; nothing tells the user it happened.
findings.fix: Remove optimistically and show an undo toast that cancels the DELETE for a few seconds.

validation.evidence: inventory destructive_actions; api.remove (src/api.ts:3) issues DELETE directly; no confirm, dialog or undo in the file.
validation.intent_checked: No trash or archive step exists in the API module.

evidence.caption: Source lines at src/components/TaskList.tsx:16, captured from the reviewed checkout

findings.title: 480px sidebar overflows the 360px phone viewport
findings.criterion: Supported viewports 360–1280 (docs/design.md:3); WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.10 Reflow
findings.observed: .sidebar { width: 480px; flex-shrink: 0; } with no rule for small screens
findings.expected: The sidebar collapses or stacks below 640px; the task list is visible without horizontal scrolling.
findings.impact: On a phone the task list starts 480px to the right: the primary flow requires horizontal scrolling to begin.
findings.fix: Make the sidebar a drawer below the 640px breakpoint and let it shrink above it (Standard tier; the mockup also draws Full and Minimal).

findings.title: Viewport meta disables pinch zoom
findings.criterion: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.4 Resize Text
findings.observed: maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no
findings.expected: width=device-width, initial-scale=1
findings.impact: Low-vision users cannot enlarge 12–15px text on phones (Safari ignores it, Chrome and others honour it).
findings.fix: Drop maximum-scale and user-scalable from the viewport meta.

validation.evidence: inventory viewport_meta blocks_zoom: true; index.html is the single entry page.
validation.intent_checked: No comment explains it; to stop iOS zooming into inputs, set inputs to at least 16px instead.

evidence.caption: Source lines at index.html:5, captured from the reviewed checkout

findings.title: Add-task dialog does not trap or return focus, or close on Escape
findings.criterion: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.3 Focus Order; ARIA APG dialog pattern
findings.observed: <div className="modal panel"> with no role, aria-modal, focus move, Escape handler or focus return
findings.expected: role="dialog" aria-modal with a label; focus moves into it, Tab stays inside, Escape closes, focus returns to "New task".
findings.impact: Keyboard users tab behind the open dialog and screen readers do not announce it; adding a task is slow and confusing.
findings.fix: Use a dialog primitive (native <dialog> with showModal(), or the design system's) instead of a positioned div.

validation.evidence: AddTaskModal.tsx:7-12 has no focus or key handling; Dashboard.tsx:19 renders it inline.
validation.intent_checked: No dialog library is installed or imported.

evidence.caption: Source lines at src/components/AddTaskModal.tsx:7, captured from the reviewed checkout

findings.title: Archive has a route but no navigation entry
findings.criterion: Every supported task is reachable from the navigation (findability heuristic)
findings.observed: Nav links / and /settings; /archive is defined in App.tsx but nothing links to it
findings.expected: An "Archive" item in the main navigation or a link from the task list.
findings.impact: Members cannot find archived tasks unless they type the URL: a secondary task is blocked.
findings.fix: Add a NavLink to /archive.

validation.evidence: inventory orphan_routes lists /archive; no href, to= or navigate() reaches it.
validation.intent_checked: Archive.tsx is complete, not behind a feature flag.

evidence.caption: Source lines at src/components/Nav.tsx:7, captured from the reviewed checkout

findings.title: Email error appears on the first keystroke
findings.criterion: Validate on blur or submit, not while typing (form usability heuristic)
findings.observed: onChange runs the email check and sets "Invalid input" until the address is complete
findings.expected: Check on blur and on submit; once shown, clear the message as soon as the value becomes valid.
findings.impact: Every visitor sees an error while typing a correct address, at the first step of the product.
findings.fix: Move the check to onBlur and submit; keep the live re-check only after the first error.

validation.evidence: onEmail is the email input's onChange (SignupForm.tsx:26).
validation.intent_checked: No debounce or touched-state guard.

evidence.caption: Source lines at src/components/SignupForm.tsx:11, captured from the reviewed checkout

findings.title: Sign-up fields are labelled only by placeholders
findings.criterion: WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions; SC 1.3.1 Info and Relationships
findings.observed: <input name="email" placeholder="Email"> and <input type="password" placeholder=…> with no <label>, aria-label or aria-labelledby
findings.expected: A visible <label> tied to each field.
findings.impact: The field name disappears as soon as the visitor types, and the accessible name depends on a placeholder that vanishes on input.
findings.fix: Add a visible <label htmlFor> for each field.

validation.evidence: inventory inputs: label missing, placeholder_only on both fields.
validation.intent_checked: No wrapping <label> or aria-label.

evidence.caption: Source lines at src/components/SignupForm.tsx:26, captured from the reviewed checkout

findings.title: Task list has no loading, empty or error state
findings.criterion: Visibility of system status; every data view has loading, empty and error states
findings.observed: fetch(...).then(setTasks) with no pending flag, no catch and no zero-items branch
findings.expected: A skeleton while loading, an empty state that offers "New task", and an error with retry.
findings.impact: A new member sees a blank area and cannot tell "loading", "no tasks" and "failed" apart; failures are silent.
findings.fix: Track status (loading / error / ready) and render the three states; add .catch with a retry.

validation.evidence: inventory state_branches: TaskList.tsx missing loading, error, empty.
validation.intent_checked: No Suspense or error boundary wraps TaskList in Dashboard.tsx.

mockup.note: The list is blank in every state today: compare each state's fix.

findings.title: Sign-up errors say "Invalid input" and "Error 500"
findings.criterion: Error messages say what went wrong and how to fix it (WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.3 Error Suggestion)
findings.observed: "invalid": "Invalid input", "failed": "Error 500"
findings.expected: "Enter an email like name@example.com" / "We couldn't create your account. Try again in a minute."
findings.impact: Visitors do not learn what to change; a status code reads as a crash.
findings.fix: Rewrite both strings in every locale; distinguish "email taken" from server failure.

validation.evidence: Both keys are rendered by SignupForm.tsx:11 and :20.
validation.intent_checked: Copy only; brand voice is out of scope (brand-scan).

evidence.caption: Source lines at src/i18n/en.json:4, captured from the reviewed checkout

findings.title: Two primary buttons compete on the dashboard
findings.criterion: One primary action per view (visual hierarchy)
findings.observed: "New task" and "Import" both variant="primary", side by side
findings.expected: "New task" primary; "Import" secondary or in an overflow menu.
findings.impact: The main action of the product has no visual priority over a rarely used one.
findings.fix: Make Import variant="secondary".

findings.title: The Import button does nothing
findings.criterion: Every control responds to input; nothing fails silently
findings.observed: <Button variant="primary">{t("task.import")}</Button> with no onClick
findings.expected: Import opens an import flow, or the button is removed until one exists.
findings.impact: A prominent primary-styled button gives no response, so users retry or assume the app is broken.
findings.fix: Wire Import to its flow or remove it.

validation.intent_checked: No feature flag or disabled state marks it as coming soon.

findings.title: Settings "Save" is a hand-styled link: no keyboard access, off-system style
findings.criterion: Use the design-system Button for actions; WCAG 2.2 SC 2.1.1 Keyboard
findings.observed: <a className="save-link" style={{ padding: 10, background: "#2563eb" }} onClick={save}> without href
findings.expected: <Button variant="primary" onClick={save}>
findings.impact: Save cannot be reached with Tab and looks unlike every other button: a secondary task is blocked for keyboard users.
findings.fix: Replace the anchor with the shared Button component.

validation.evidence: inventory click_handlers (a without href) and spacing 10px off the scale.
validation.intent_checked: Button.tsx exists and is used on the dashboard.

evidence.caption: Source lines at src/pages/Settings.tsx:9, captured from the reviewed checkout

findings.title: Focus outline removed from every .btn button with no replacement
findings.criterion: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.7 Focus Visible
findings.observed: .btn:focus { outline: none; }
findings.expected: .btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; } (or a --focus token added to tokens.css)
findings.impact: Keyboard users lose track of where they are on every screen that uses the shared button.
findings.fix: Delete the rule and add a :focus-visible style from the tokens.

validation.evidence: inventory focus_outline: no replacement in the rule, no :focus-visible in the file or tokens.css.
validation.intent_checked: No global focus style elsewhere.

evidence.caption: Source lines at src/styles/app.css:4, captured from the reviewed checkout

findings.title: Task titles are cut at 120px with no way to read the rest
findings.criterion: Truncation keeps the full text available (title, tooltip or detail view); labels fit the longest shipped locale (de)
findings.observed: .task-title { max-width: 120px; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis } on the row's <div> (TaskList.tsx:15), with no title attribute
findings.expected: Titles wrap to two lines (line-clamp) and the full title is exposed; truncation only where the full text is available.
findings.impact: Users cannot tell similar tasks apart ("Prepare quarterly…"), and longer German titles lose most of their text.
findings.fix: Let .task-title wrap or clamp to two lines and expose the full title; drop the max-width that has no effect on the inline .btn-label.

validation.evidence: inventory truncation app.css:13; .task-title is a block <div> (TaskList.tsx:15), so max-width and the ellipsis apply. .btn-label is an inline <span> (Button.tsx:4), so its button labels are not cut.
validation.intent_checked: Exact width depends on the font and the title; not rendered.

evidence.caption: Source lines at src/styles/app.css:13, captured from the reviewed checkout

findings.title: Email field typed as text, and sign-up fields have no autocomplete
findings.criterion: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose
findings.observed: type="text" name="email"; neither field sets autocomplete
findings.expected: type="email" autocomplete="email"; autocomplete="new-password".
findings.impact: Phones show the wrong keyboard and password managers do not fill or save the new password.
findings.fix: Set the email input type and both autocomplete tokens.

validation.evidence: inventory inputs: autocomplete and type=email missing.
validation.intent_checked: No custom autofill handling.

evidence.caption: Source lines at src/components/SignupForm.tsx:26, captured from the reviewed checkout

findings.title: "Create account" stays active while the request runs
findings.criterion: Pending state on submit; prevent double submission
findings.observed: No pending state; the button is never disabled or relabelled
findings.expected: aria-busy / disabled with "Creating account…" until the response.
findings.impact: Slow networks invite a second click and a duplicate request; there is no sign that anything happened.
findings.fix: Track a submitting flag; disable the button and show progress while it is set.

validation.evidence: inventory state_branches: SignupForm.tsx missing loading.
validation.intent_checked: The API's duplicate handling was not read.

evidence.caption: Source lines at src/components/SignupForm.tsx:30, captured from the reviewed checkout

findings.title: Avatars have no alt text
findings.criterion: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.1.1 Non-text Content
findings.expected: alt="" when the assignee's name is shown beside it, otherwise alt with the name.
findings.impact: Screen readers announce the image file name on every row.
findings.fix: Add alt.

findings.expected: width={24} height={24}, or a fixed size on .avatar.
findings.impact: Rows jump as avatars load, moving the delete icon under the pointer.
findings.fix: Add width and height, or size .avatar in CSS.

findings.title: Spacing and type literals off the token scales
findings.criterion: Spacing scale 4/8/12/16/24/32 and type scale 12–32 (src/styles/tokens.css:2-3)
findings.observed: padding: 13px; margin-bottom: 18px; font-size: 15px
findings.expected: var(--space-3), var(--space-4), var(--text-md)
findings.impact: Cards and headings sit off the rhythm of the rest of the UI.
findings.fix: Replace the literals with the nearest tokens.

validation.evidence: inventory off_scale: spacing 13px, 18px, 10px; font_sizes 15px. The 10px is Settings.tsx:9, which U-016's fix replaces.
validation.intent_checked: No comment justifies the values.

evidence.caption: Source lines at src/styles/app.css:7, captured from the reviewed checkout

findings.title: Unused .dropdown class sets z-index 99999, above the modal and toast layers
findings.criterion: Layer scale dropdown 10 < modal 100 < toast 1000 (docs/design.md:7)
findings.observed: .dropdown { z-index: 99999 }
findings.expected: z-index: var(--z-dropdown)
findings.impact: No user sees it today; the first dropdown built on this class would cover a dialog opened from it and hide toasts.
findings.fix: Use the token, or delete the class until a dropdown exists.

validation.evidence: inventory off_scale z_index 99999; no component references .dropdown.
validation.intent_checked: No dropdown component exists yet; the class is shared CSS.

evidence.caption: Source lines at src/styles/app.css:9, captured from the reviewed checkout

findings.title: Declared motion has no reduced-motion path
findings.criterion: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions (AAA); platform reduced-motion setting
findings.observed: .panel { transition: transform 600ms } and an infinite .spinner animation, with no reduced-motion query
findings.expected: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .panel { transition: none } }; 200–300ms for the panel.
findings.impact: No motion reaches users today; once the dialog animates its entrance or a spinner is used, it would move for 0.6s or spin even for people who asked their OS for less motion.
findings.fix: Shorten the transition and add a reduced-motion override.

validation.evidence: inventory motion: 2 declarations, reduced_motion empty. The dialog mounts conditionally (Dashboard.tsx:19) and nothing changes its transform, so the transition never runs; no component uses .spinner.
validation.intent_checked: No JS motion library.

evidence.caption: Source lines at src/styles/app.css:15, captured from the reviewed checkout

findings.title: Skip link z-index 9999 off the layer scale
findings.criterion: Layer scale (src/styles/tokens.css:4)
findings.observed: .skip-link:focus { z-index: 9999 }
findings.impact: None: a focused skip link must sit above everything.
findings.fix: None.

validation.evidence: The value applies only while the skip link has focus; topmost is the intent.

checked_ok: Main navigation is a <nav> with a label, and NavLink sets aria-current on the active item.
Add-task and settings inputs have programmatic labels; settings name has autocomplete="name".
<html lang="en"> and a skip link to #main are present.
limitations: This is fictional sample data for the renderer, not a review of a real product.
Static review: nothing was rendered, so contrast, exact truncation widths and overlap are inferred from code.
To keep the sample small, only three findings carry mockups; these visible High and Medium findings have none: U-001, U-002, U-005, U-009, U-010, U-011, U-013, U-015, U-016, U-017 and U-018.
U-006 carries the three tiers (Full, Standard, Minimal); to keep the sample small, U-012 and U-014 keep one proposal each.
decisions: Is /signup intentionally reachable only from the marketing site? It has no in-app link (inventory orphan_routes).
Hover and selected states are undefined in the tokens; decide whether the design system should own them.
next_steps: Fix U-001 to U-006 first: they block the two primary flows.
Enlarge .icon-btn (app.css:12) to at least 24x24px, 44 preferred, with the U-004 and U-005 fixes.
Re-run inventory.py --flows after the fixes and render the dashboard at 360px to confirm U-006 and U-018.
